program.section_heading: Sociology Associate in Arts for Transfer (AA-T)
outcomes: Demonstrate an understanding of the major theoretical perspectives, concepts and research findings in the field of sociology.
Utilize critical thinking skills to analyze, evaluate and make decisions regarding current issues studied in the field of sociology.
Recognize the diversity of social, cultural and global perspectives.
Demonstrate knowledge of the principles of research and the ethical considerations involved in conducting research.
Understand how theoretical perspectives can explain both the causes and the solutions to social problems.
